nl: In config/app.json, set features.beta_ui to true. The file must stay valid JSON with all other values unchanged.

entries.content_utf8:
# Database settings
[database]
url = "postgres://db.example.com:5432/orders"
pool_size = 10
timeout_seconds = 30

[database.replica]
url = "postgres://replica.example.com:5432/orders"
enabled = false

service: orders
replicas: 2
image: ghcr.io/example/orders:2.3.0
resources:
  memory: 512Mi
  cpu: 500m
env:
  LOG_LEVEL: info
  REGION: eu-central

[server]
host = 0.0.0.0
port = 8080
debug = true

[mail]
sender = orders@example.com
smtp = smtp.example.com

reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
p = 'config/app.json'
d = json.load(open(p, encoding='utf-8'))
d['features']['beta_ui'] = True
open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(json.dumps(d, indent=2) + '\n')
EOF
